section.title: omega coverage
section.text:
ADX: 14-period average directional index (trend strength, 0–100). ADX_RSI14_spread: % gap ADX vs RSI14. ADX_RSI14_spread_mean3: windowed mean. close: the bar's close price. close_touch: band proximity (upper / lower / none). ADX_zone: thresholded regime (overbought / oversold / neutral). zones: the ACTIVE structure-zone set (fair-value gaps and order blocks). zones_count: number of ACTIVE structure zones. MACD: MACD histogram — the 12/26 line minus its 9-period signal. MACD_cross: crossover event (Bullish / Bearish). ADX_er: efficiency ratio over the last 3 points of a level series, |last − first| ÷ Σ|consecutive change| — 1 is a straight move, near 0 is chop. ADX_maxShare: largest share of the last 3 observations, max ÷ Σ — 1 is one bar carrying everything, 1/3 is perfectly even. zones_support_age_h: hours since the nearest support zone was detected. zones_support_dist: signed % from price to the nearest support zone midpoint. zones_resist_range: nearest resist zone price range (low–high). zones_resist_type: nearest resist zone type.
